items.title: perf(ci): avoid repeated worker package-owner lookups (#195191)
items.summary: perf(ci): avoid repeated worker package-owner lookups (#195191) Visit each ancestor once while capturing worker compiler package inputs. Sibling and nested packages retain their nearest manifest, and subsequent build phases reuse the same completed walks. Replay of the actual callback over two recorded full inventories reduces package existence probes from 2642 to 1007 with the same 267 manifests. This measures operations, not elapsed-time or billing savings. Focused real native worker/SDK proof, scripts typecheck, scoped lint, format and independent review pass.

items.title: fix(android): Talk button demands a realtime provider on a native Tal…
items.summary: fix(android): Talk button demands a realtime provider on a native Talk setup (#191194) fix(android): admit native Talk without a realtime provider On a Gateway that is set up for native Talk, the Android Talk button still required a realtime provider and showed "Configure a Realtime Talk provider on the Gateway". Android now combines the Gateway's Talk catalog readiness with the existing Talk configuration parser. It uses that result when the composer starts Talk or resumes after microphone permission, and it refreshes cached readiness after configuration changes. Evidence: built APKs from main and this change on a real Android emulator, paired to a built Gateway configured for native Talk with no realtime provider. Main showed the realtime-provider dialog (both runs). With this change, native Talk starts: "Listening — Native Talk: using device speech recognition and configured Talk voice." (both runs). A Gateway with a realtime provider behaves the same on both. 59 tests and ktlint pass. Screenshots and details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191194#issuecomment-6720016627. The linked issue also reports a separate dictation symptom; this change does not cover it. Landed with maintainer approval: review proof 5/6 and patch 4/6, and the review recommends landing after CI. Its 3/6 overall rating reflects only the uncovered dictation symptom. Thanks @saariuslystoned. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: chore: trace first-run Gateway work and verify later replies (#195185)
items.summary: chore: trace first-run Gateway work and verify later replies (#195185) * perf(gateway): trim cold setup detection work Compile only model info for disposable Apple Foundation Models discovery and load the setup detection owner without the activation barrel. Keep full optimized inference compilation on explicit selection. Extend the isolated first-run workload with opt-in server attribution and a third real reply. Performance acceptance is measured separately; no session or database runtime behavior changes. * test(perf): wait for completed first-run replies Keep the strict unique reply assertion while excluding the streaming working placeholder from readiness. Firefox can expose that placeholder beside the reply during the third turn. * perf(gateway): keep setup detection import timing unchanged Isolate the Apple info-only compilation change. The wider setup candidate improved detection medians but failed later-turn latency and CPU guardrails, so retain the existing detector barrel and its tests. * test(perf): retain diagnostics after rejecting runtime candidates The Apple-only candidate improved setup detection but failed first-reply and later CPU guardrails in the paired Firefox run. Restore the native helper and retain only the reusable first-run benchmark improvements.

items.title: fix(knowledge): keep deleted messages out of reply previews (#195126)
items.summary: fix(knowledge): keep deleted messages out of reply previews (#195126) fix(knowledge): mark deleted targets in cross-day reply previews In standalone chat-transcript output, a reply preview that pointed at a message from an earlier day still quoted the original text after the target was deleted (deleted_at set). The target's own transcript already shows the existing "[deleted]" marker. Reply previews now use that same marker before the quote is truncated. Raw JSONL is unchanged. Evidence: the packaged standalone CLI. Main quoted the deleted text in the cross-day reply preview; with this change it shows [deleted]. Ordinary cross-day and same-day replies, a missing target, and raw JSONL and chunk integrity are unchanged. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195126#issuecomment-6720191000. Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
